summary: This guide covers optimal team compositions and strategies for the Continental Challenge boss Joyce. Joyce is an AoE-focused boss who summons clones and gains 25% Damage Up and 60% Defense Up buffs on an 18-second rotation. To maximize score, teams must bring a buff dispeller timed to clear these buffs immediately after application. Aura teams featuring Talethia and Burn teams featuring Durem are demonstrated at both Inspiration 0 and Inspiration 5 levels.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Cleanses all allied debuffs and strips all enemy buffs with a 100% chance on her ultimate.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Deals massive AoE damage scaling off HP% rather than Attack%.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Shares attack with Talethia and applies debuffs to amplify overall team damage.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Grants significant damage bonuses and shares attack with the highest attack Aura damage dealer.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Provides high healing, damage reduction, and ultimate energy cycling for maximum score.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Deals immense AoE damage on Joyce, scaling drastically with Inspiration 5 defense ignore.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Strips boss buffs and reduces boss ultimate energy by 25% when timed correctly.

heroes.name: Mithrasea
heroes.note: Keeps low-inspiration Burn teams alive through Joyce's heavy AoE attacks.

heroes.name: Paixton
heroes.note: Wears the Puppeteer set and shares attack stats with Durem.

heroes.name: Karf
heroes.note: Applies debuffs and provides extra attack sharing to boost team DPS.

teams.note: Highest damage Aura team using Anneliesis to dispel Joyce's buffs on an 18-second rotation.
Top F2P-friendly Burn team relying on Journ for buff dispel and Mithrasea for revives.

meta_changes: Aura and Burn teams excel against Joyce due to AoE skill scaling and predictable 18-second buff cycles.
tips: Time your dispeller's ultimate (Anneliesis or Journ) to execute right after Joyce applies her 18-second damage and defense buffs.
Equip Talethia with HP% chest gear instead of Attack%, as her skill damage scales directly from HP.
Journ does not require Skill Haste when manually timed for an 18.2-second recast cycle.
